1: Un logon ke liye halakat aur ghaata hai jo naap mein kami karte hain.
2: Yeh woh log hain jo jab doosron se apne liye naapte hain, to apna poora haqq bina kisi kami ke lete hain.
3: Magar jab logon ke liye naapte ya tolte hain, to naap aur tol mein kami kar dete hain. Yeh Madinah walon ka tareeqa tha us waqt jab Nabi ﷺ un ki taraf hijrat kar ke tashreef laaye.
4: Kya yeh log, jo yeh bura kaam karte hain, nahin jaante ke unhein Allah ke saamne dobara zinda kiya jayega?
5: Hisaab aur badle ke liye, ek aise din jo apni aazmaishon aur hebat ki wajah se bara hai.
6: Us din log tamam makhlooq ke Rubb ke saamne hisaab ke liye khare honge.
7: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa tum ne samjha, ke marne ke baad dobara zinda hona nahin. Kafiron aur munafiqon mein se nafarmani karne walon ka aamaal-naama sab se neechi zameen mein ghaate ki jagah par hoga.
8: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ko kya maloom ke Sijjeen kya hai?
9: Un ka aamaal-naama likha hua hai aur woh mitega nahin. Na us mein koi izafa hoga aur na kami.
10: Us din jhutlane walon ke liye halakat aur ghaata hai,
11: un logon ke liye jo badle ke din ka inkaar karte hain, jis din Allah apne bandon ko un ke duniya mein kiye hue aamaal ka badla dega.
12: Us din ka inkaar sirf wohi shaks karta hai jo Allah ki hadon se barhta hai aur bakasrat gunah karta hai.
13: Jab us ke saamne meri woh aayatein parhi jaati hain jo maine apne Rasool par utari, to woh kehta hai: yeh pehli qaumon ke qisse hain, Allah ki taraf se nahin.
14: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa in jhutlane walon ne samjha. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo gunah woh karte rahe, unhon ne un ke dilon par ghalba kar liya aur unhein dhanp liya, is liye woh apne dilon se haqq na dekh sake.
15: Beshak qayamat ke din unhein apne Rubb ke deedar se roka jayega.
16: Phir woh aag mein daakhil honge aur us ki garmi bardasht karenge.
17: Phir qayamat ke din unhein malamat aur sarzanish ke taur par kaha jayega: yeh azaab, jo tumhein mila, wohi hai jis ka tum duniya mein inkaar karte thay jab tumhara Rasool tumhein us ki khabar deta tha.
18: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa tum ne samjha, ke koi hisaab aur badla nahin. Farmanbardari karne walon ka aamaal-naama Illiyyeen mein hoga.
19: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ko kya maloom ke Illiyyeen kya hai?
20: Un ka aamaal-naama likha hua hai aur woh mitega nahin. Na us mein koi izafa hoga aur na kami.
21: Is aamaal-naame par har aasman ke muqarrab farishte gawah hain.
22: Jo log bakasrat neik aamaal karte hain, woh qayamat ke din hamesha rehne wali niyamat mein honge.
23: Sajay hue takhton par baithe apne Rubb ko dekhte honge, aur har us cheez ko jo un ke dilon ko bhaati aur khush karti hai.
24: Agar aap unhein dekhein, to un ke chehron par aish ka asar nazar aayega, un ke husn aur raunaq mein.
25: Un ke khadim unhein muhar-band bartanon se sharab pilayenge.
26: Us ke aakhir tak mushk ki khushboo aati rahegi. Isi mukarram ajr ke liye muqabla karne walon ko muqabla karna chahiye, Allah ki pasand ka kaam kar ke aur us ki naraazi ki cheezein chhor kar.
27: Yeh muhar-band mashroob Tasneem ke chashme se mila kar tayyar kiya jayega.
28: Yeh jannat ke buland tareen hisse ka ek chashma hai, jis se muqarrab log khaalis pee'enge aur baaqi momin usey doosre mashroobon ke saath mila kar pee'enge.
29: Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kar ke zulm kiya, woh iman walon par thatta kar ke hanste thay.
30: Jab woh mominon ke paas se guzarte, to mazaq aur dil lagi mein ek doosre ko aankh maarte.
31: Jab apne gharon ko lautte, to apne kufr aur mominon ke mazaq par khush ho kar lautte.
32: Jab woh Musalmanon ko dekhte, to kehte: yeh log haqq ke raaste se bhatak gaye hain, kyunke unhon ne apne baap-dada ka deen chhor diya.
33: Allah ne unhein mominon ke aamaal ka nigehban nahin banaya tha ke woh yeh baat keh sakein.
34: Qayamat ke din Allah par iman rakhne wale kafiron par hansenge, jis tarah kafir duniya mein un par hanste thay.
35: Sajay hue takhton par baithe woh us hamesha rehne wali niyamat ko dekhenge jo Allah ne un ke liye tayyar ki.
36: Kafiron ko un ke duniya mein kiye hue aamaal ke badle mein zillat ka azaab diya gaya hai.
